ERCOT Queue Detective

Every month, ERCOT publishes the Generator Interconnection Status (GIS) report — a spreadsheet listing every proposed power plant in Texas that has requested a grid connection study. This tool tracks that queue month-over-month and surfaces what changed: new entrants, projects that advanced through studies, capacity revisions, COD slips, and withdrawals.

The queue is the leading indicator of Texas grid buildout — 6-18 months ahead of permits and construction. Right now there are 440+ GW of proposed generation in queue, dominated by solar, BESS, and gas.

Data source

Raw data: ERCOT GIS Report. Downloaded monthly, parsed from Excel, stored in SQLite. Not affiliated with or endorsed by ERCOT. Source: public ERCOT data, used under ERCOT's open data policy.

JSON API

All endpoints return JSON and are freely usable for non-commercial purposes.

GET /api/summary
GET /api/projects?fuel=SOL&min_mw=100&changed_since=2026-06-01
GET /api/projects/{'{'}inr{'}'}
GET /api/movers?change_type=NEW
GET /api/filters

Example: biggest new projects this month

curl /api/movers?change_type=NEW | jq '.movers[] | {name: .project_name, mw: .capacity_mw}'

Example: all COD slips above 500 MW

curl "/api/projects?change_type=COD_SLIPPED&min_mw=500&changed_since=2026-06-01"

Built at

Candid Intelligence Hackathon, Houston, August 2026. Stack: Python + SQLite + FastAPI + Astro + MapLibre GL JS.
